title: Stacked 75
subtitle: A 75-key case of sheets, drawn around its circuit board
summary: A 75-key case made of acrylic sheet with its edges built from short pieces and corner blocks. The circuit board is part of the Fusion assembly, so the case is drawn around it. The file was saved 40 times.

sections.heading: Where the board sits
sections.body: Cut through from front to back, the order is keycap, switch, plate, board and base, with a post at the front corner carrying the stack. At the front edge the plate has 2.3 mm above it and 1.2 mm below.

sections.heading: In other sheet
sections.body: Renders of the same files in other materials and light. Studies, not builds.

sections.heading: Saved 40 times
sections.body: Fusion kept every save of the file. The strip shows the saves where the most changed between one version and the next.
